title: movie-planner-web changelog release
description: One user-relevant release, as the `changelog` content collection exposes it to /changelog (src/lib/changelog/loader.ts, content.config.ts). Derived from CHANGELOG.md, which release-please maintains — see src/lib/changelog/parse.ts for the parsing and the internal-scope filtering (a release with nothing user-relevant left never produces one of these). This documents the existing shape independently of the internal Zod schema; it doesn't change the parsing pipeline.

version.description: release-please's own semver, without a leading 'v' (e.g. "0.90.2").

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, taken from the release heading release-please writes.

type.description: "feature" for a Conventional Commits `feat`, "fix" for a `fix` — release-please's own "Features"/"Bug Fixes" section headings.

scope.description: The commit's Conventional Commits scope (e.g. "caldav", "overview"). Never an internal scope like "ci" or "deps" — parse.ts filters those out before an entry reaches this shape.
